parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of non-dimensional coordinates being demoted to variables during the coarsen operation. The changes are minimal and focused on the core functionality.

issues.description: The code could be slightly more readable by adding comments to explain the logic of handling coordinates and non-coordinate variables separately.
